question: If the interior angle of a regular polygon is k times its exterior angle, express the number of sides (n) of the polygon in terms of k.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interior angle + Exterior angle = 180°

Given Interior angle = k × Exterior angle

∴ (k + 1) × Exterior angle = 180° ⇒ Exterior angle = 180° ÷ (k + 1)

Number of sides (n) = 360° ÷ Exterior angle

n = 360° ÷ [180° ÷ (k + 1)] = 2k + 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2k + 2.**
